Marriages
Mary Carney de-
Friday 6 day of December
parted this life one one
in the year of our Loro
one thousand eight hun-
dred & thirty nine
being thirty eight
years four months &
eighteen days old
38y 4mo 18d
Florence L. Cott
and Paul. Baker
were married Oct.4
1928 in Gratiot co
Mich.
Florence died-
heart attack
Feb.19,1975
